# porch_application_share (Resource)

Shares an application owned by one tenant with another tenant (ADR-0034): members of the target tenant pass the tenant gate of the application, subject to its access mode and the owner's deny policies. Cross-tenant shares are an installation matter and need an installation `admin` token. Import with `<tenant>/<application_id>/<target_tenant>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Members of the Joneses can use the Smiths' Jellyfin.
resource "porch_application_share" "jellyfin_joneses" {
  tenant         = porch_tenant.smiths.id
  application_id = porch_application.jellyfin.id
  target_tenant  = porch_tenant.joneses.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) ID of the shared application. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `target_tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant the application is shared with. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tenant` (String) ID or slug of the tenant that owns this object. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<tenant>/<application_id>/<target_tenant>`.
- `target_tenant_id` (String) ID of the target tenant.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import porch_application_share.jellyfin_joneses <tenant>/<application_id>/<target_tenant>
```
